conviction_note: No news and no new filing explain today's -16.5%. It is one more leg of a collapse from $9.90 (2026-09-09) to $1.04, on 1.33x volume. The one sourced thing that bears on the window is an open $100m Maxim ATM (filed 2026-09-11) on a roughly $36m equity, which can sell into any bounce. Against that, light volume and the -25..-15 band are mild positives in the cross-section. So abs_move 10 (own median absolute next-session move 9.12%, ATR 60%) times p_up 42 gives -1.6, close to the single finding's -1.5.

No 6-K or press release has appeared since 2026-09-11, and the move continues a slide from $9.90 to $1.04 that followed the Landvision share-for-share acquisition (30m new shares at $8, closed 2026-08-07) and a $100m ATM opened 2026-09-11.

evidence.claim: On 2026-09-11 a $100m ATM was opened with Maxim Group under F-3 333-296481, against 34,198,442 shares outstanding. The 424B5 cover gives a $9.90 close on 9/9 and $5.10 on 9/10.
The 6-K announcing the ATM agreement: sales are at the company's discretion and the company has no obligation to sell.
No filing after 2026-09-11 in the issuer's EDGAR submissions as pulled at 19:05 UTC today.
The latest issuer news headline is dated 2026-07-17 (the Landvision acquisition); nothing since.

pipeline.next_dated_event: Best-endeavours F-1 resale registration for the 30m Landvision consideration shares, due about 2026-11-07 (three months after the 2026-08-07 completion). The first lock-up release (20% of 26m) is at six months, about 2027-02. Both fall outside the window.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: A 6-K tonight that terminates or suspends the Maxim ATM, or one that discloses a buyback or insider purchase, would remove the supply leg.

positioning_check: Nasdaq short interest at the 2026-09-15 settlement was 45,970 shares, 1.0 days to cover on 198,409 average daily volume, up from 2,981 at 2026-08-31 (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/MKDW/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). That data lags about eight business days and is three weeks stale, so the position carried into today cannot be observed. Against 34.2m shares outstanding it is negligible. 76.4% of votes sit with the CEO and 20 concert shareholders (13D/A 2026-08-27), and 26m of the consideration shares are locked up, so the free float is small. There is no options market and no skew.

findings.finding: The open $100m Maxim ATM (424B5, 2026-09-11) can sell shares at the company's discretion in the 2026-10-08 session. At roughly $36m of equity, the program is several times the market cap, and supply caps any bounce from today's low.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The ATM is effective and needs no new filing to draw, so sales can happen on any day, including 2026-10-08. This is standing supply inside the window, not a dated event after it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the ATM opened on 2026-09-11 the stock has gone from about $7.75 (5.10 × 1.52) to $1.04. Its September falls after the ATM were followed by -17.87% (9/18), -20.37% (9/21) and -9.3% (9/22) next closes, and -1.64% after 9/14, per the baseline history. Which of those days had ATM sales is not disclosed.
findings.why_not_priced: The ATM has been public for 26 days, so its existence is priced. What the price does not hold is the next session's supply. A bounce would meet agent selling, and the name's history of falls on less than 2x volume continuing (up-rate 32% against 49.7% cross-section) is what that looks like. If it were fully priced, the drift after the ATM would have stopped. It has not.
findings.independence: The issuer's 6-K of 2026-09-11 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1991332/000149315226042408/form6-k.htm) is the same fact. The 20-day run-up of -88% in the baseline points the same way, but it is not independent evidence of ATM sales.

outside_window.finding: Under the 424B5 risk factor, because the 1-for-30 reverse split took effect 2026-01-26, a bid below $1.00 within a year of the split brings no 180-day compliance period and can lead straight to a Staff Delisting Determination. At $1.04 the stock is 4% above that line, but the deficiency itself needs 30 consecutive business days below $1.00, so nothing can be determined inside the window.
